notes: NOVA RIDE edge with Raven's edge onset (Kris, by ear, 2026-11-22, "version 8"; project session listening tests). Nova has no edge captures; its EDGE row plays a copy of the bow shoulder. Mode weights (velw, one set for every row): Nova's edge today, exc_norm x the bow-shoulder velocity table (V4 column) x edge_weight, peak 1, in mode order of nova_vel_participation.json (2270 modes). Envelopes (7 rows, 22 plugin bands, 20 ms frames, 30 s): per band and row, the build-up to the band's peak follows Raven's edge at the same NPZ row (raven_edge_npz_data.json, its envelope x edge_rms_correction x the band's velw norm; bands with no Raven edge modes take the nearest band's timing); the band's peak level is Nova's edge at full velocity (rendered today) x how much Raven's band peak changes from full velocity to that row (soft hits darker); after the peak the band rings as Nova's edge does today at that velocity (rendered band envelope, extended past 11.5 s by its late decay). Rows at velocities 0.1097-1.0, set so the edge level follows velocity^1.5 (with level_vel_gain_power 1.5): -20.5, -14.0, -8.8, -6.2, -2.6 and 0 dB at 0.2, 0.35, 0.5, 0.65, 0.8 and 1.0. edge_rms_correction 1 / each band's velw norm (geometric mean 1, no clamp: every band's level is set by its envelope). The bake block lists the bake settings the plugin needs; the last two are engine rules (the PR's prompt).
